title.rendered: Half Moon Bay Ritz Carlton Wedding DJ

content.rendered:
Half Moon Bay Ritz Carlton Wedding DJ

Wedding Ceremony & Reception for Christine & Lei on Sunday, January 26, 2014

Reception Infomation

A reception will follow immediately after the ceremony on the Gazebo Lawn, during which refreshments and hors d’oeuvres will be served.

Dinner and dancing will be held during the evening in the Ritz-Carlton ballroom and terrace following the reception on the mezzaine level. Outdoor heaters will be placed on the terrace but please be sure to bring a light jacket or cardigan as it may still be chilly.

Name: Christine Peng
From Queens NY 11104
 Event: Wedding
Location: Half Moon Bay Ritz Carlton

1 Miramontes Point Road, Half Moon Bay, CA.
Ceremony on the Gazebo Lawn
Reception Ritz Carlton Ballroom.
Guests: 85
Date: Sunday, January 26, 2014
Times: 3:30 PM to 10:00 PM

 

_______________________________________________________________________________________
Songlist for Ceremony & Reception.

Prelude

Bach, Air (“on the G string”, string orchestra)

Seating
Rachmaninoff’s “Rhapsody on a Theme of Paganini”
Ceremony – Ceremony will be outside on the Gazebo Lawn , HMB Ritz Carlton.
Seating of Mothers /Bridesmaids/Groomsmen/Groom: Canon In D
Brides Entrance Song: Liz on Top of the World (movie Pride and Prejudice)
Song is 1.20 seconds long is that enough time for you to go down the Aisle. i can also loop the song.

Bride and Groom Exit Song: Nothing’s Gonna Stop Us Now (Starship)

End of Ceremony Announcement –
“Ladies and Gentlemen please stand and put your hands together for the first time Mr. and Mrs. Lei and Christine Zhu”

Cocktails/Reception – mix of classical slow and upbeat happy music – cocktails will be outside on the Gazebo Lawn
The Lake (The Notebook;Aaron Zigman)
Happy (Pharrell Williams)
Fun Fun Fun (Pharrell Williams)
I’m Forrest (Forest Gump; Alan Silvestri)
The Cider House Rules: Main title (Rachel Portman)
A Time for Us (Romeo and Juliet; Nino Rota)
The Holiday (movie anything upbeat; Hans Zimmer)
Michael Buble (anything)
Music for Announcing The Wedding Party –
Main Title from “Father of the Bride”

Wedding Party Names –

Bridesmaid: Alyssa Hodge
Groomsman: Scotty Tran

Maid of Honor: Rebecca Vanard
Groomsman: Evan Li

Matron of Honor: Janette Chen (Bride’s sister)
Best Man: Tony Chen (Bride’s bother-in-law)
*Confetti Poppers*
Music for Announcing The Newlyweds –
Signed, Sealed & Delivered (Stevie Wonder)

Music for 1st Dance Bride & Groom –
A Thousand Years (Christina Perri)

Music for 2nd Dance Father/Daughter –
The Way You Look Tonight – Frank Sinatra

Music for 3rd Dance Mother/Son – (Groom might be having 2 dances with mother and aunt)
My Guy (Mary Wells)
My Girl (The Temptations)

Background Dinner Music – Dinner is in the Ritz-Carlton Ballroom.
Wherever Would I Be (Dusty Springfield and Daryl Hall)
Believe (Cher)
After All (Cher ft. Peter Cetera)
Sweetest Thing – U2
Desert Rose – Sting
Kashmir – Led Zepplin
What About Love – Heart
I Want To Know What Love Is – Foreigner
Police – Every Breath You Take
Sting
Lady Antebellum – Need You Now
Phil Collins – In the Air Tonight
Daryl Hall & John Oates – Maneater
Music for Toasting – (TBD: 30 minutes after dinner)
That’s Amore (movie Moonstruck)

Toasts Will Be Made By –
Groomsman: Scotty Tran
Maid of Honor: Rebecca Vanard
Groom’s Mother: Zimei Li

After Dinning Dancing – Disc Jockey – every 10 songs 1 slow dancing song
Joan Jett – I Love Rock n’ Roll
Capital Cities – Safe and Sound
Aerosmith – I Don’t Want to Miss a Thing
Gin Wigmore – Black Sheep
Bruno Mars – Just The Way You Are, Grenade, Locked out of Heaven (anything else Bruno Mars)
Celine Dion  – Loved Me Back to Life
Louis Armstrong  – What A Wonderful World
Katy Perry – Roar, California Girl, Thinking of You
One Republic – Stop and Stare, Good Life, All the Right Moves
Maroon 5 –
Rihanna – Stay, etc
Eminem – Love The Way You Lie (ft. Rihanna)
Selena Gomez – Come and Get It
Adele – Skyfall, etc
Seal – Stand By Me
Mandy Moore – Have A Little Faith In Me
Michael Bolton – When A Man Loves A Woman
Kylie Minogue – DJs
Britney Spears – Toxic
Kylie Minogue – Can’t Get You Outta My Head
Kelly Clarkson – Already Gone, etc
Madonna – Give Me All Your Luvin
Black Eye Peas
Daft Punk – Get Lucky (ft. Pharrell Williams)
Beyonce – Halo, Put A Ring On It
Music for Bouquet Toss –
Girls Just Want to Have Fun (Cindy Lauper)
Pre-Cake Cutting Announcement –
“Ladies and Gentlemen, the Bride and Groom ask that you please join them as they cut the cake”
Music for Cake Cutting –
Recipe For Love (Harry Connick Jr.)
*Do Not Play List*
Country
Taylor Swift
Rap

_________________________________________________________________________________________

 

California Disc Jockey Uplight Rentals.

3 Pinspots for the Cake

20 white uplights Ritz Carlton Ballroom
